But yoke:2 distributes fullness EVENLY across the whole body edge (Front Body span 453.3 mm) while the flat hangs one CENTER INVERTED BOX PLEAT from the yoke with the rest of the body flat. learnings.capability: Center inverted box pleat (localized fullness from a yoke or waist, rest of body flat)
learnings.note: The single top Round-5 capability. It is the ONLY feature standing between #12 and wearable (its yoke/facing/collar/sleeve all draft clean at 0 issues now). Unlike the yoke/facing/placket/top fixes (validator bugs), this is a genuine NEW construction primitive: the first LOCALIZED fullness (one center inverted pleat) rather than distributed gather. A pleatStyle / box-pleat panel that plants a center inverted pleat and keeps the rest flat moves #12 partial->wearable AND becomes reusable for pleated hems and pleated skirts. Would take the set to 12 wearable / 2 partial.
